bullets.zh: 协助组织 27 场公共课程活动，按首次参与和复访分组，为 124 名报名者发送不同的行前提醒与课后资料。
bullets.en: Helped organize 27 public courses and grouped 124 registrants by first-time or returning participation to send relevant pre-event reminders and follow-up materials.

bullets.zh: 汇总签到与反馈记录，与课程策划及场地团队调整下一轮活动说明，并跟进资料更新。
bullets.en: Summarized attendance and feedback records, coordinated updates to the next event brief with course planners and venue staff, and followed up on revised materials.

bullets.zh: 协调 12 个社区活动点的报名与到场咨询，记录 86 条参与者问题，并与志愿讲师和场地方核对安排。
bullets.en: Coordinated registration and arrival enquiries across 12 community venues, recorded 86 participant questions, and confirmed arrangements with volunteer facilitators and venue staff.

bullets.zh: 归类报名页面报错和场地指引不清等反馈，用工单记录责任人、处理状态与回访结果。
bullets.en: Categorized reports of registration-page errors and unclear venue directions, then used tickets to track owners, status, and follow-up outcomes.

bullets.zh: 将重复出现的报名系统问题整理成图文操作卡，供参与者和活动点志愿者查阅。
bullets.en: Turned recurring registration-system issues into illustrated instruction cards for participants and venue volunteers.

entries.title_en: Atlas Content Lab | Visitor-Service Content Processing

bullets.zh: 将 29 份展览设备手册按型号、故障类型和操作步骤清洗并结构化，供活动志愿者查询。
bullets.en: Cleaned and structured 29 exhibition-equipment manuals by model, issue type, and operating step for volunteer reference.

bullets.zh: 根据展馆服务问题编写 72 条问答条目，标记复核状态并维护内容版本。
bullets.en: Wrote 72 visitor-service question-and-answer entries, marked review status, and maintained content versions.

bullets.zh: 核对扫描手册的 OCR 识别结果与原始页面，修正图文说明中设备编号的误识别。
bullets.en: Checked OCR output from scanned manuals against original pages and corrected misread equipment identifiers in illustrated instructions.

bullets.zh: 设计社区活动议题记录、追问与历史查询流程，限制模型替志愿者作出判断，并约束输出结构。
bullets.en: Designed agenda capture, follow-up, and history lookup for community-event retrospectives, limiting automated judgments about volunteers and defining structured output.

bullets.zh: 用三类会议场景编写 18 条离线样本，检查记录完整性、来源表述和遗漏事项；项目停留在本地原型阶段。
bullets.en: Prepared 18 offline examples across three meeting scenarios to check completeness, source wording, and missing action items; the project remained a local prototype.

bullets.zh: 围绕无障碍设施、开放时段和交通方式设计社区场地筛选与比较路径，并用分类标签组织资料。
bullets.en: Designed venue filtering and comparison around accessibility, opening hours, and transport options, organizing information with categories and tags.

bullets.zh: 整理 74 张社区场地信息卡和 12 篇使用指南，通过分类、筛选与对比页呈现演示资料。
bullets.en: Prepared 74 community-venue cards and 12 usage guides, presenting demonstration data through categories, filters, and comparison pages.

bullets.zh: 配置本地 CSV 与 JSON 数据源及加载失败提示，标明场地信息仅供演示、需要自行核实。
bullets.en: Configured local CSV and JSON data sources with loading-failure notices, labeling venue details as demonstration data requiring independent verification.

bullets.zh: 围绕公开建筑档案设计资料检索与练习路径，准备 33 张资料卡和 9 道带来源的练习题。
bullets.en: Designed a source-led study path for public architecture archives, preparing 33 reference cards and nine cited practice questions.

bullets.zh: 搭建本地资料检索原型，按问题相似度排序并最多展示三条来源引用；没有生产环境用户。
bullets.en: Built a local retrieval prototype that ranked archive items by question similarity and displayed up to three source citations; it had no production users.
